Q: Why can a lock lease expire while its worker is still performing a write?
spoken: A lease bounds ownership in time; it cannot stop a paused or partitioned worker from resuming later. Use a receiver-enforced generation or fencing token when stale writers must be rejected. Keep operation identity and idempotency separate from lock ownership, and test pause, expiry and restart behavior.
